notes.title: Devs play Dead Finger Dice
notes.notes: [p]Hello, all![/p][p][b]Today @ 2PM EST[/b] Lindsay, 1/3 of Rocket Adrift will be playing the demo for Dead Finger Dice: The Billionaire Killing Game [b]live on stream[/b]![/p][p]Join and watch as she rolls against the first two bosses, walks through how to play and offers insights on the development experience of this Balatro-inspired dice-builder.[/p]
